# 0) Initialization

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggh4x)

# Source scripts (make sure model_functions_ingestion.R + analysis_functions_ingestion.R are updated as we did)
file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)

tr <- list(
  # --- Activity metabolism ---
  a_A = 80,
  b_R = 0.78,

  # --- Oxygen supply ---
  a_O = 5,
  b_d = 0.75,
  b_v = 0.15,

  # --- Hill kinetics ---
  K_g = 2.0,
  h_g = 2.0,

  # --- Encounter ---
  a_E = 20,
  b_E = 2 / 3,

  # --- Processing ---
  a_C = 60,
  b_C = 0.75,

  # --- Maintenance ---
  alpha_M = 0.1,
  b_M = 0.75,

  # --- Intake partition fractions ---
  alpha_SDA = 0.2,
  alpha_exc = 0.1,

  # --- Temperature (Arrhenius default) ---
  T_ref = 10,
  E_M = 0.50,
  E_C = 0.50,
  E_A = 0.10,
  E_O = 0.25
)

pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.1)
```


# 1) Test diagnostics (single mass/temperature): pO2 vs Prey index

```{r}
d_test <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses = 1e4, Tseq = 10, pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = seq(0, 1, by = 0.004),
  prey_units = "prey_index",
  pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    M_m_norm   = M_m / Cmax,
    M_act_norm = M_act / Cmax,
    D_SDA_norm = D_SDA / Cmax,
    M_exc_norm = M_exc / Cmax,
    A_assim_norm = A_assim / Cmax
  )

# Optional interpolation per plot (choose only when you want it):
#d_test_ip_E <- interp_surface(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="E_net_norm", nx=350, ny=350) %>% add_masks()
```


# 2) pO2 vs prey density (four separate 4-panel plots)

```{r}
d_prey <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses=c(1e1,1e5), Tseq=c(5,25), pO2seq=pO2seq,
  preys=seq(0,1,length.out=220), prey_units="prey_index",
  pair_mode="cross", progress=TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = c(1e1, 1e5),
                    labels = c("w == 10^1~g", "w == 10^5~g")),
    T_lab = factor(T, levels = c(5, 25), labels = c("T = 5°C", "T = 25°C"))
  )
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
d_prey <- d_prey %>%
  mutate(
    # Total aerobic metabolic demand (respired components)
    M_tot_aero = M_m + M_act + D_SDA,

    # Effective MI using realized supply (dimensionless)
    MI_eff = if_else(is.finite(O2_supply) & is.finite(M_tot_aero) & M_tot_aero > 0,
                     O2_supply / M_tot_aero, NA_real_),

    # Optional: MI analogue using environmental pO2 (estimate kO from the run)
    kO_est = if_else(is.finite(O2_supply) & is.finite(pO2) & is.finite(pO2_int) & (pO2 > pO2_int),
                     O2_supply / (pO2 - pO2_int), NA_real_),
    MI_env = if_else(is.finite(kO_est) & is.finite(M_tot_aero) & M_tot_aero > 0,
                     kO_est * pO2 / M_tot_aero, NA_real_),

    # FAL = total aerobic / basal
    FAL = if_else(is.finite(M_m) & M_m > 0 & is.finite(M_tot_aero),
                  M_tot_aero / M_m, NA_real_)
  )

# MI_env surface
plot_surface_masked(d_prey, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="MI_env",
                    palette="red", fill_title="MI_env (O2_supply / demand)",
                    x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours=contour_spec(z="MI_env", breaks=c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8), linewidth=0.22, alpha=1),
                    theme=th) +
  facet_grid2(rows=vars(T_lab), cols=vars(mass_lab), labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.2), labels=function(x) ifelse(x %in% c(0,1), as.character(as.integer(x)), sprintf("%.1f", x)),
                     limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0,0)) +
  labs(title="Effective metabolic index", x="Prey index", y=expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)"))

# FAL surface
plot_surface_masked(d_prey, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="FAL",
                    palette="red", fill_title="FAL = (Mm+Ma+SDA)/Mm",
                    x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours=contour_spec(z="FAL", breaks=c(1.5, 2, 2.5, 3), linewidth=0.22, alpha=1), 
                    theme=th) +
  facet_grid2(rows=vars(T_lab), cols=vars(mass_lab), labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.2), labels=function(x) ifelse(x %in% c(0,1), as.character(as.integer(x)), sprintf("%.1f", x)),
                     limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0,0)) +
  labs(title="Factorial aerobic load", x="Prey index", y=expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)"))
```


# 3) Feeding level: pO2 vs temperature (four separate 4-panel plots)


# 5) Metabolic allocation (stacked; explicit excretion)

```{r metabolic-allocation}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 120)
scen <- tribble(
  ~scenario, ~T, ~pO2, ~f_ref,
  "Baseline", 10, 25, 0.75,
  "Hyperthermic", 25, 25, 0.75,
  "Hypoxic", 10, 10, 0.75,
  "Oligotrophic", 10, 25, 0.50
)

alloc_state <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scen, function(scenario, T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)), w = mass_seq, tr = tr,
                    T_ref = rep(10, length(mass_seq)), pO2_ref = rep(25, length(mass_seq)),
                    U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5, enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE)
  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, w = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(
      scenario = scenario,
      mass = m,
      Cmax = st$Cmax,
      f = st$f,
      g = st$g,
      U = st$U_opt,
      `Basal metabolism` = st$M_m,
```

```{r}
prey_seq <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.002)

scenario_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  scenario = c("Baseline", "Hyperthermic", "Hypoxic"),
  mass = c(1e1, 1e5)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(
      mass,
      levels = c(1e1, 1e5),
      labels = c("10^1~g", "10^5~g")
    ),
    T = dplyr::case_when(
      scenario == "Baseline" ~ 10,
      scenario == "Hyperthermic" ~ 30,
      scenario == "Hypoxic" ~ 10
    ),
    pO2 = dplyr::case_when(
      scenario == "Baseline" ~ 25,
      scenario == "Hyperthermic" ~ 25,
      scenario == "Hypoxic" ~ 10
    )
  )

U_series <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  scenario_grid,
  function(scenario, mass, mass_lab, T, pO2) {

    d <- compute_state_surface(
      tr,
      masses = mass,
      Tseq = T,
      pO2seq = pO2,
      preys = prey_seq,
      prey_units = "prey_index",
      pair_mode = "cross",
      progress = TRUE
    )

    d %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        scenario = scenario,
        mass_lab = mass_lab,
        E_ok = is.finite(E_net) & (E_net > 0),
        lty = dplyr::if_else(E_ok, "Positive E_avail", "Negative/NA E_avail")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(f_ref) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        seg_id = cumsum(dplyr::coalesce(lty != dplyr::lag(lty), TRUE))
      )
  }
)
```

```{r}
  filter(T_lo == 5, T_hi == 15) %>%   # keep this if the CSV has T segments

```


```{r}
find_zero_crossing <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]; y <- y[o]

  # exact zero
  iz <- which(y == 0)
  if (length(iz) > 0) return(x[min(iz)])

  s <- sign(y)
  idx <- which(s[-length(s)] * s[-1] < 0)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  i <- idx[1]
  x1 <- x[i]; x2 <- x[i+1]
  y1 <- y[i]; y2 <- y[i+1]
  x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
}
```

```{r}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(0, 6, by = 1)   # 1e0 to 1e6
pO2_seq  <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.1)

f_ref_use <- 0.75   # Prey index OR feeding level target

  tr,
  masses = mass_seq,
  Tseq   = 10,
  pO2seq = pO2_seq,
  preys  = f_ref_use,
  prey_units = "prey_index",   # or "feeding_level"
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Fit: log10(pO2_thr) ~ alpha + beta*log10(mass)
fit_scaling <- function(df, ycol) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[ycol]]), .data[[ycol]] > 0, is.finite(mass), mass > 0) %>%
    mutate(logy = log10(.data[[ycol]]), logm = log10(mass))

  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(tibble(n = nrow(d), alpha = NA_real_, beta = NA_real_, r2 = NA_real_, A = NA_real_))

  fit <- lm(logy ~ logm, data = d)
  co <- coef(fit)
  tibble(
    n = nrow(d),
    alpha = unname(co[1]),
    beta  = unname(co[2]),
    r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    A = 10^unname(co[1])
  )
}

scaling_E0 <- fit_scaling(thr_mass, "pO2_E0") %>% mutate(threshold = "E_net = 0")
scaling_SD <- fit_scaling(thr_mass, "pO2_SD") %>% mutate(threshold = "O2 supply = demand")
# add FWB occurrences?

bind_rows(scaling_E0, scaling_SD)
```

```{r metabolic-allocation-8panel, warning=FALSE}
  "Oligotrophic+Hyperthermic",
  "Oligotrophic+Hypoxic",
  "Hyperthermic+Hypoxic",
  "Hyperthermic+Hypoxic+\nOligotrophic"
)

scen_all <- tribble(
  ~scenario, ~T, ~pO2, ~f_ref,
  "Baseline",                           10, 25, 0.75,
  "Oligotrophic",                       10, 25, 0.50,
  "Hyperthermic",                       25, 25, 0.75,
  "Hypoxic",                            10, 10, 0.75,
  "Oligotrophic+Hyperthermic",          25, 25, 0.50,
  "Oligotrophic+Hypoxic",               10, 10, 0.50,
  "Hyperthermic+Hypoxic",               25, 10, 0.75,
  "Hyperthermic+Hypoxic+\nOligotrophic",  25, 10, 0.50
)

process_levels <- c(
  "Basal metabolism",
  "Active metabolism",
  "SDA",
  "Excretion",
  "Available energy"
)

alloc_cols <- c(
  "Basal metabolism" = "#440154",
  "Active metabolism" = "#8a5796",
  "SDA" = "#e0bce8",
  "Excretion" = "gray90",
  "Available energy" = "#67A5CA"
)

mass_seq <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 120)

alloc_state8 <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scen_all, function(scenario, T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(
    f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)),
    w = mass_seq,
    tr = tr,
    T_ref = rep(10, length(mass_seq)),
    pO2_ref = rep(25, length(mass_seq)),
    U_lo = 1e-5,
    U_mech = 5,
    enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE
  )

  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(
      pO2_env = pO2, T = T, w = m, prey = B, tr = tr,
      U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5
    )

    tibble(
      scenario = scenario,
      mass = m,
      Cmax = st$Cmax,
      f = st$f,
      g = st$g,
      #fg = st$f * st$g,
      U = st$U_opt,
      `Basal metabolism` = st$M_m,
      `Active metabolism` = st$M_act,
      SDA = st$D_SDA,
      Excretion = st$M_exc,
      `Available energy` = st$E_net
    )
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_order),
    M_total = Excretion + SDA + `Basal metabolism` + `Active metabolism`
  )

alloc_long8 <- alloc_state8 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(process_levels),
    names_to = "Process",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value_norm = value / Cmax,
    Process = factor(Process, levels = process_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario, mass, Process)

fg_long8 <- alloc_state8 %>%
  select(scenario, mass, f, g) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(g, f),
    names_to = "Limiter",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Limiter = factor(Limiter, levels = c("f", "g"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario, mass, Limiter)

# Allocation + f/g/fg overlay
ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = alloc_long8,
    aes(x = mass, y = value_norm, fill = Process, group = Process),
    position = "stack",
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = fg_long8,
    aes(x = mass, y = value, colour = Limiter, group = Limiter),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alloc_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(g = "#6a51a3", f = "#238b45")) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = 10^c(-2, 0, 2, 4),
    labels = label_10pow(),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Body mass, w (g)",
    y = expression("Allocation / " * C[max]),
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL#,
    #title = "Metabolic allocation scenarios with f, g, and f·g"
  ) +
  th
```

```{r}
U_scaling8 <- alloc_state8 %>%
  filter(is.finite(U), U > 0, is.finite(mass), mass > 0) %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    beta  = coef(lm(log10(U) ~ log10(mass)))[["log10(mass)"]],
    alpha = coef(lm(log10(U) ~ log10(mass)))[["(Intercept)"]],
    r2    = summary(lm(log10(U) ~ log10(mass)))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(A = 10^alpha)
```

# 10) Prey compensation pO2-v-T (4 panels)

```{r prey-compensation-pO2T, warning=FALSE}
d_comp_pi <- compute_state_surface(tr, masses = c(1e1, 1e5), Tseq = seq(0,30,by=0.25), pO2seq = pO2seq,
                                   preys = 0.75, prey_units = "prey_index", pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE)
d_comp_fl <- compute_state_surface(tr, masses = c(1e1, 1e5), Tseq = seq(0,30,by=0.25), pO2seq = pO2seq,
                                   preys = 0.75, prey_units = "feeding_level", pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE)

d_comp <- bind_rows(
  d_comp_pi %>% mutate(row_lab = "Prey index = 0.75"),
  d_comp_fl %>% mutate(row_lab = "feeding level = 0.75")
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = c(1e1, 1e5),
                    labels = c("w == 10^1~g", "w == 10^5~g")),
    row_lab = factor(row_lab, levels = c("Prey index = 0.75", "feeding level = 0.75"))
  )

plot_surface_masked(d_comp, x = "T", y = "pO2", z = "E_net_norm", palette = "blue",
                    fill_title = "Available energy", x_limits = c(0,30), y_limits = c(0,30),
                    contours = list(
                      contour_spec(z = "f", breaks = seq(0,1,0.2), colour = "#238b45", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
                      contour_spec(z = "g", breaks = seq(0,1,0.2), colour = "#6a51a3", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed")
                    ),
                    contour_data = d_comp,
                    theme = th) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(row_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab), labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,10,20,30), limits = c(0,30), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,10,20,30), limits = c(0,30), expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(x = "Temperature, T (°C)", y = expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)"))
```
